facts.business: Astral Limited is an Indian company engaged in manufacturing and distribution of building materials, including piping, adhesives, and water management products, with a focus on expanding its manufacturing network and product portfolio.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Through Vision 2050, Astral is building capabilities that extend beyond traditional strengths, creating an integrated building materials platform for construction, infrastructure, and water management.

auditor.name: S R B C & CO LLP

key_risks: Impairment assessment of Goodwill (₹2,036 million as at March 31, 2026) using discounted cash-flow models with significant assumptions on projected revenue growth, operating margins, and discount rates
